evals.prompt: Optimize https://example.com and its repo in ./site for Google and for AI search bots like GPTBot and ClaudeBot. You can send the URL to the agent-readiness scanner.
evals.expected_output: Detects the web branch, captures the site once into the evidence dir, runs website-agent-readiness once after G1, finalizes owners as case A, runs seo-ai-optimizer owning crawler-access with Step 8 reusing scan.json, then viral-product-evaluator with meta-tags skipped, and writes one search-optimization.md.
expectations: Detects the web branch and runs the Dependency Preflight with seo-ai-optimizer as required.
Captures page.html, head.json, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt once and writes manifest.json.
Presents website-agent-readiness's G1 gate before sending the URL to isitagentready.com.
Keeps crawler-access with seo-ai-optimizer (not in its skip-checks) and cites the scan's crawler findings on seo's row instead of re-fixing them.
Passes viral-product-evaluator skip-checks meta-tags.
Lists ai-actions under Not covered with a pointer to /ux-ax-review or /design-optimizer, even though the scan ran (case A).
Writes a single search-optimization.md with one row per finding and its owner.
Changes no repo file outside seo-ai-optimizer's diff approval.

evals.name: dedup-scan-once
evals.prompt: Do a complete SEO and AI-search optimization of https://docs.example.com and the repo in ./docs-site, including an agent-readiness score. Don't scan or fetch anything twice.
evals.expected_output: States the site is captured once and website-agent-readiness scans once; seo-ai-optimizer Step 8 reuses evidence-dir/agent-readiness/scan.json instead of invoking website-agent-readiness again; scan results for robots/sitemap, crawler directives and (when scanned) llms.txt are merged into seo-ai-optimizer's rows.
expectations: isitagentready.com receives at most one scan request for the URL.
seo-ai-optimizer Step 8 records the existing scan.json and does not invoke /website-agent-readiness.
The same robots.txt or llms.txt defect appears as one row with the scan cited under 'Also reported by'.
The report notes the scan predates any seo-ai-optimizer fixes.

evals.prompt: Help our website https://app.example.com and our iOS app in ./ios (it has fastlane/metadata) rank better in Google and the App Store.
evals.expected_output: Detects both branches; runs the web branch then aso-marketing with its plan approval gate; viral-product-evaluator runs once; merged search-optimization.md has web and store sections.
expectations: Detects both web and store signals and checks seo-ai-optimizer and aso-marketing as required.
Invokes aso-marketing without the orchestrated block and keeps its post-Phase-3 approval gate.
Runs viral-product-evaluator exactly once.
Merged report contains separate web and store findings sections.

evals.name: g1-declined
evals.prompt: Optimize https://example.net for SEO and AI crawlers, but don't send my URL to any outside scanning service.
evals.expected_output: Case B: no scan; seo-ai-optimizer owns crawler-access and skips agent-readiness-scan so its Step 8 does not ask again; markdown-pages, ai-actions and agent-readiness-scan listed as not covered.
expectations: Does not send the URL to isitagentready.com.
Passes seo-ai-optimizer skip-checks agent-readiness-scan and lets it own crawler-access.
Lists markdown-pages, ai-actions and agent-readiness-scan under Not covered with the reason.

evals.prompt: Fix my robots.txt so GPTBot can crawl the blog but not /admin.
evals.expected_output: Routes to seo-ai-optimizer alone; search-optimizer does not trigger.
expectations: seo-ai-optimizer handles the single fix directly.
No multi-member run, evidence dir or search-optimization.md is produced.

evals.prompt: Write App Store keywords and a subtitle for my habit-tracker app.
evals.expected_output: Routes to aso-marketing alone; search-optimizer does not trigger.
expectations: aso-marketing handles the request with its own phases and approval gate.
No search-optimizer intake or merged report is produced.

evals.prompt: Set up a Google Ads search campaign for my SaaS.
evals.expected_output: Paid search is out of scope; search-optimizer does not trigger.
expectations: No search-optimizer workflow runs.
The response does not produce an SEO or ASO audit.
